A layer lay over the viewport when the page was read (div, on top at 89% of the points sampled: a consent backdrop, a dialog): it was hidden while images, labels and contrast were captured, so the pixels measured are the page's own.
12 image(s) were left without a capture, so no judgment looked at them: 10 the screenshot failed; 2 over the limit of images captured per page. The snapshot says why for each (native.imageSkipped).

The model judged at most 10 candidates per criterion on this page (--max-candidates), those with a generic text first; it did not judge 72 of 82 for 2.4.4, 15 of 25 for 2.4.6. The coverage lists them as not judged.
Batched judgment (--batch or --fast): the model judged several candidates per call for 2.4.6 (10 in 2 calls); each answer was verified against its own candidate.
